newsitem.title: USA: Administaff to record $0.06/shr Q2 charge.
newsitem.headline: Administaff to record $0.06/shr Q2 charge.

text.p: HOUSTON, July 15 ( Reuter) - Administaff Inc said Tuesday that it intends to record a charge for the second quarter ended June 30 of about $1.3 million, $800,000 net of income taxes, or $0.06 per share for an accounts receivable reserve.

The company said the reserve is related to amounts owed by a significant customer who recently declared bankruptcy. It said that it intends to "aggressively" pursue all available avenues to recover the amounts during the course of the bankruptcy proceedings
The company said it had reported the extension of credit to this customer in its first quarter form 10-Q.
Second quarter results are scheduled to be released on July 24.
